Maya: Quick flag — Jordan Rivera (candidate) onsite tomorrow 2:00pm PT. We have an overlap: Alex and Priya both booked for system-design. Can one of you switch to soft-skills? Need debrief lead confirmed.
Alex: I can swap out of soft-skills only if Samir covers my system-design slot. Heads down on release otherwise.
Priya: I can't do 2pm PT (10pm my time). If it's moved to 3pm PT I can take system-design.
Samir: I can cover system-design but prefer 3pm PT. If Jordan ok with 3pm I'm in.
Maya: Jordan said 3pm PT works. I'll update calendar. Moving panel to 3pm PT and shifting debrief to 4:15pm PT.
calendar-bot: Event updated — Jordan Rivera onsite panel moved to 3:00pm PT. Zoom: https://zoom.us/j/1234567890. Organizer: Maya.
Jordan: Quick ask from hiring side — can we align on the soft-skills rubric? For this role we're weighing communication, curiosity, and mentorship aptitude. Also who will lead the debrief?
Priya: I can lead debrief if Alex can take notes. Quick rubric question: do we score soft-skills 1-4 or Pass/Fail this cycle?
Alex: We use 1-4 across all panels. I'll take notes and fill the eval form. Maya — can you post the eval link here?
Maya: Eval form: https://forms.redwood.com/evals/jordan-rivera — please submit within 24h after debrief. Debrief agenda: 5m intro, 15m notes + consensus, 5m decision
Samir: One more logistics note — for the system-design prompt, can we give Jordan 10 minutes to prep? I think 5 is too tight for the API sketch.
Jordan: Yes, give 10 minutes prep. Priya please lead the API prompt; Alex capture tradeoffs and performance notes.
Priya: Will do. Thanks everyone — see you at 3pm PT. :thumbsup:
